verdict.rationale: Freshsales' own API documents CRUD on core records, a Bulk Upsert Contact endpoint, and a Job Status endpoint for tracking async bulk work, which covers the write and upsert side of a sync. Nothing in the evidence documents rate limits or change detection (updated-since filters, change feeds, webhooks), so the read side of bidirectional sync at scale is unproven. Missing for 10: documented rate limits, change detection/incremental sync mechanism, upserts beyond contacts, independent corroboration of at-scale sync.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync records bidirectionally through the API at scale, with documented rate limits, upserts, and change detection

citations.quote: such as reading, modifying, adding or deleting data from your helpdesk.
